description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. List certificate applications already filed at Hometax (민원증명 발급 목록) with their receipt ids (cvaId, rcatNo). Read-only. Without strt_dt/end_dt only the last 3 days are returned, so an empty result does not mean the taxpayer has no certificates — widen the period to look further back. Send both dates or neither. One call covers at most one calendar month (strt_dt no earlier than end_dt minus one month); a longer period is refused, because the institution returns an empty list for it instead of an error — split it into monthly calls. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

end_dt.description: Application end date YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; omitting it means today. Send together with strt_dt.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.

strt_dt.description: Application start date YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; omitting it means 3 days ago. Send together with end_dt. No earlier than end_dt minus one month.
